message: First tunnel reports local live/ready but zero successful cloud polls and repeated 30-second transport failures. Direct API connectivity times out; existing macOS system proxy returns HTTP. Applied supported control-plane-only proxy flag; awaiting actual restarted-client poll evidence. ChatGPT setup rate-limit symptom has not been independently attributed.

evidence.summary: Direct TCP timeout at 4 seconds; existing system HTTPS proxy returned HTTP in about 0.5 seconds
